notes.mahoney-college: OSM's building for Mahoney Residential College has no name or building tag, so the cache misses it; pinned at its address, 1101 Stanford Drive (Nominatim way/1013234311; housing.miami.edu), beside the Mahoney-Pearson Dining Hall.
notes.pearson-college: OSM's building for Pearson Residential College has no name or building tag, so the cache misses it; pinned at its address, 5185 Ponce de Leon Boulevard (Nominatim way/190557243; housing.miami.edu), the east tower of the Mahoney-Pearson pair.
notes.ibis-college: Coral and Ibis Residential Colleges share one OSM building (relation/17960362, 'Centennial Village - Coral & Ibis Residential Colleges', 1239 Dickenson Drive); Coral matched it by name, and Ibis is pinned on its east end so the two get separate spots.
